workflows.trigger: Windows bootstrap, repair, relocation, or path-sensitive troubleshooting.
steps: Read the current machine-profile codebase map and detector output.
Select environmentRoleId explicitly or from a local binding; do not infer it from profileId.
Consume repository.recommendedRoot/pathRoles.developmentCheckout from current machine-profile evidence.
Verify origin, branch, HEAD, and dirty state before mutation.
Use isolated ownership for separately owned work.
Choose validation or failure recovery before issuing a next command.

workflows.trigger: Operational role, trap, workflow, report, detector integration, or path-policy change.
steps: Run the operational Python contract.
Run the operational PowerShell contract.
Run the current machine-profile bootstrap contracts.
Run affected broader Windows-profile/device-profile gates when registered.
Run git diff --check and preserve exact-head evidence.

workflows.trigger: Any nonzero detector, bootstrap, setup, certification, or operational-harness command.
steps: Stop downstream execution.
Checkpoint command, shell, exit code, role, profileId, repository-root source, branch, HEAD, and dirty state.
Classify path, Git, prerequisite, deterministic defect, protected-runtime, or external dependency.
Search known traps and current owner tests.
Repair only the owning surface.
Rerun the failed stage, owning validator, then broader safe gate.

workflows.trigger: Sprint end, review boundary, reboot boundary, runtime stop, or chat transfer.
steps: Resolve branch and HEAD from Git.
Name the repository-root source without committing the resolved private path.
Order next work by dependency and owner.
Emit a location-independent exact next command.
Advance to the next unproven gate instead of rerunning completed proof.
